map.分辨本领：光学系统能区分两点的最小角距离。瑞利判据 θ_min≈1.22·λ/D: Resolving power: the smallest angular separation at which an optical system can distinguish two points. The Rayleigh criterion gives θ_min≈1.22·λ/D (λ wavelength, D aperture).
map.θ_min 越小分辨率越高；增大孔径 D 或使用短波长 λ 可提升分辨极限。 m: The smaller θ_min is, the higher the resolution; increasing the aperture D or using a shorter wavelength λ improves the resolution limit, a core constraint in microscope and telescope design.
map.瑞利判据分辨本领（本页代码口径）：R = D÷(1.22×λ)（1/m，D 孔径: Rayleigh resolving power (as implemented here): R = D÷(1.22×λ) (1/m, D aperture in m, λ entered in nm and ×10⁻⁹ to m, 1.22 the circular-aperture Airy coefficient); linked values: minimum resolvable angle = 1.22×λ÷max(D,10⁻¹²) (rad), arcseconds = ×206265, R (1/mm) = R÷1000. Validation: both inputs are guarded against blanks and a blank shows a prompt; when D is 0 the denominator is floored at 10⁻¹². Criteria: no fixed grading; a larger aperture or shorter wavelength resolves better, and a smaller arcsecond value means higher resolution.
map.瑞利角分辨（本页代码口径）：最小分辨角 θ_min = 1.22×λ÷D（rad: Rayleigh angular resolution (as implemented here): minimum resolvable angle θ_min = 1.22×λ÷D (rad; D in m, λ entered in nm and converted with 10⁻⁹, 1.22 is the Airy-disk coefficient); angular resolution power = 1÷θ_min = D÷(1.22×λ) (rad⁻¹, numerically the limiting line pairs per radian); arcseconds = θ_min×206265. Validation: D and λ are required and both must be > 0; no denominator fallback is used. Criteria: a smaller θ_min means higher angular resolution; D÷(1.22×λ) on this page is not the spectral resolving power λ/Δλ.
map.角分辨本领越大越好？: Is a larger angular resolution power better?
map.1/θ_min 越大→可分辨的角距离越小；本页不把它当作光谱分辨本领 λ/Δλ。: A larger 1/θ_min means a smaller resolvable angular separation; this page does not treat it as spectral resolving power λ/Δλ.
map.二者相关但不同：瑞利判据给 θ_min=1.22λ/D；光谱分辨本领 λ/Δλ: They are related but different: the Rayleigh criterion gives θ_min=1.22λ/D; spectral resolving power λ/Δλ needs parameters of the dispersive system and cannot be obtained from D and λ alone.
